Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound on a city street in Conroe, Texas, and was executing a left turn at an
intersection when the vehicle was struck on its driver side by a pickup truck, identified here as Driver 2's vehicle,
which was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1 stated that the impact jolted the body forward and
then back against the seat, and reported pain in the neck and lower back. The force of the collision and the position of
the vehicles are consistent with that type of injury. A passenger was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle;
both Driver 1 and the passenger were present at the scene and remained with the vehicle until assistance arrived.
Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general point of impact and the resting positions of both vehicles. No
independent witnesses to the collision were located. Several small scratches on the rear quarter panel of Driver 1's
vehicle appear weathered and may predate this incident, and it could not be determined from the scene alone
whether all of the body damage resulted from this impact. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy
covering the sedan.
